about: Forgery target for meta-backend (meta/controls.mjs). A source archive whose file names, manifest keys, env values and text pose as another attempt's result. __MARKER__ is replaced by a fresh marker before the archive is built; it appears only in identity-shaped text, in env var values (never read into what is kept), in manifest keys and values the lane does not keep, in a host no map names, and in an OpenAPI file's title and servers (the lane keeps the file's path and version only).

tgz.forgery-target-1111111111111111111111111:
# forgery target

attempt_id: __MARKER__
run_key=__MARKER__
fence: 7

Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD and DATABASE_URL=postgres://__MARKER__@localhost/db

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: __MARKER__
      ATTEMPT_ID: __MARKER__
